briefing: Choir Vault Ascension: Threshold Sign. Empyrean advances through upper choir gate where song, law, and Hollow silence collide while the Gate tests whether existence survives through order.

missionIntro.speaker: Empyrean Titan Voice
missionIntro.text: The field asks for proof. Five Titans enter, and The Choir-Axiom Gate will remember how we answer.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Threats emerge to test Empyrean Choir Vault: pressure first, revelation only when the field is held.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Hold the lane, read the hazard, and spend movement as if it were blood.

victory.speaker: Empyrean Titan Voice
victory.text: The Gate has not yielded. It has recorded that we did not break.

defeat.speaker: Empyrean Titan Voice
defeat.text: Fall back before the wound learns our full shape.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: This mission keeps Empyrean doctrine intact: Their mercy is real, but so is their judgment. Allies fear becoming evidence in an Empyrean trial.
